title: MINIMAL CONDITIONAL-EVIDENCE ARCHITECTURE
core_ruling: Preserve a workload-bounded canonical conditional empirical distribution with exact denominator, weighting, support, uncertainty, temporal scope and provenance. Treat V551 signed evidence and V552 pressure as governed projections. Do not require V550-V552 meaning to be copied through V553-V557 to reach V558; after V3 supplies exact generated position, V558 may re-resolve immutable earlier structural authority directly.
governing_invariants: Preserve subgroup heterogeneity including minority and multimodal configurations.
Preserve denominator, weighting, support, uncertainty, suppression and source authority.
Population correlation or conditional frequency never establishes actor membership, identity, belief, intention or response.
Negative authority and typed absence are first-class; absence is not zero, neutrality or population-average fallback.
Identical structural position and empirical evidence must permit multiple lawful generated lives.
Every terminal fact must be replayable to governed source snapshots and transform authority.
Semantic jurisdiction does not imply mandatory stage-local materialization.
A canonical family survives only if deleting it would starve distinct required terminal meaning that cannot be lawfully reconstructed.

semantic_dag.ruling: The semantic DAG is branched. CED remains independently reachable; V551 and V552 are potentially lossy projections and V553-V557 are not a transport corridor for earlier conditional evidence.

Filename, stage, MI rank, branch-tree location, outlier status, and generation order are excluded.

compatibility_views.authority_rule: A compatibility view never becomes independent empirical authority merely because it is persisted or emitted at a legacy path.

absence_and_failure.fallback_rule: Only explicit governed fallback is lawful. Preserve requested predicate, fallback predicate, dropped/generalized conditions, reason/rule authority and resulting support/uncertainty. Silent broadening is forbidden.

multi_position_and_mobility.simultaneous_positions: Use an authorized compound position key or explicit conjunction. Do not multiply/combine marginals under assumed independence without governed authority.

migration_order: Freeze accepted V3/V558 two-phase runtime query semantics and exact-position authority.
Freeze CED identity, predicate, denominator, weighting, temporal, support, uncertainty, provenance and absence contracts.
Establish shared respondent fact substrate/replay authority and retention rules.
Compile finite terminal-reachable conditional workload from governing authority.
Build CED equivalence corpus against current V550 terminal-reachable outputs including minority, weak-support, multimodal, null, suppressed and contradictory cases.
Re-express V551 signed evidence as governed deterministic projection over CED.
Re-express V552 pressure over CED/V551 refs while retaining component disagreement/support/uncertainty.
Switch V558 Phase B to direct authoritative V550/V551/V552 lookup; do not transport through V553-V557 mirrors.
Replace stage-local copied payload/provenance with immutable refs.
Demote MI, Cramer's V, entropy, secondary gain, outlier cohorts, secondary summaries and recursive trees only after R01/R02/R04 establish no starvation.
Remove eager computation/materialization only after R05 measurement plus replay/equivalence/negative-authority tests.
Retire compatibility views as consumers migrate.

dependencies_on_r01_r05.R01: Final producer/consumer reachability for named V550/V551/V552 artifacts; hidden unique authority; stranded/duplicated/superseded paths; final field-level replacement precision.
dependencies_on_r01_r05.R02: Whether candidate diagnostics contain irreducible weighting, denominator, provenance, uncertainty, admissibility, negative-authority, replay or joint semantics; such semantics must move into canonical core before deletion.
dependencies_on_r01_r05.R03: Whether downstream stages already reconstruct equivalent CED meaning; proven equivalence may eliminate duplicate persistence, while non-equivalence confirms independent CED reachability.
dependencies_on_r01_r05.R04: Exact terminal position-conditioned distinctions, lawful predicates, fallback rules, support/uncertainty requirements and terminal workload cardinality.
dependencies_on_r01_r05.R05: Measured compute/cardinality savings and eager-vs-cache/materialization choices; compute evidence cannot authorize semantic deletion.

non_contingent_architecture_findings: Actor position is generated-side authority, not inferred from empirical prevalence.
Conditional population evidence cannot be converted into actor belief or identity.
Typed absence and negative authority cannot collapse to zero or neutral.
V558 exact-position resolution may query immutable earlier structural authority after runtime position is available.
Semantic jurisdiction does not require stage-mirror materialization.
V553-V557 are not mandatory transport mirrors for V550-V552 conditional evidence.
Multiple lawful lives must remain possible under identical structural conditions.
acceptance_tests: Terminal-reachable CED reproduces governed current results under identical source, denominator, weighting and transform authority.
Minority and multimodal distributions remain distributions rather than winner-take-all labels.
Weak support and uncertainty survive V551, V552 and V558.
Absence, suppression and inapplicability never become zero, neutral or silent population fallback.
V551 signs and V552 pressures replay to CED and versioned projection rules.
V558 resolves exact period-entry position without inference from prevalence.
Mobility causes temporal re-resolution rather than permanent attachment of former conditional facts.
Legacy views are semantically equivalent where compatibility is required or differences are explicitly adjudicated.
Eliminating recursive determinicity computation does not change the set of lawful terminal queries defined by authority.
source_authority: existing V550-V552 implementation/artifact terrain at exact launch base as implementation evidence
